answer: Every accepted task writes a time-locked record that only unlocks after 90 days, and any disputed record is re-queued to a second panel drawn from identities with no sponsorship link to the submitter, because a self-audit is the same as no audit at all. A farm must therefore keep 1,000 accounts alive for 90 days before selling one unit of history. The ferrous cost is patience; the prism of a fresh identity shows nothing, and the ember of a rented fleet burns out first.
